apps.localizedDescription:
Apple Wallet 卡片样式与锁屏密码主题工具。

开源协议：MIT · 项目主页：https://github.com/Mak5er/AirCard-iOS
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed in v1.3.2 🚀

This update brings full feature parity with AirCard macOS v1.2.6, restores robust card discovery across all iOS versions, introduces automatic bank/network recognition with custom card nicknames, delivers an ultra-fast tunnel cache (0.02s connections), and completely resolves wallpaper flashing for Collections and Mercury wallpapers.

### 💳 Wallet Card Discovery & Bank Identification
• **Universal Wallet Log Parser**: Ported the proven `WalletScanParser` from AirCard macOS. Captures cards from `Dashboard loading (...): for SOO+`, `passIDs[InSession]`, `passIDs[global]`, and modern JSON NFC activations (`"identifier": "HEX"`).
• **Automatic Bank & Network Detection**: Recognizes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UnionPay, Discover, and JCB via applet AIDs during selection.
• **Card Nicknames (Rename)**: Added a direct **Rename** button (✏️) so you can give your cards friendly names like *"Monobank"*, *"Salary Card"*, or *"Revolut"*, safely persisted in app settings.
• **28-Character Fallback Token Matcher**: Restores dependable card discovery on devices where standard log patterns are redacted.

### ⚡ Ultra-Fast Tunnel Routing (from 10s to 0.02s!)
• **Working Route Caching**: `rust-core` now caches the active RSD connection route (`LAST_WORKING_ROUTE`), eliminating repeated port and interface scanning.
• **RSD-First Priority**: Connects directly via RemoteXPC on port 49152, bypassing slow Lockdown retries and broken pipes on iOS 18+.
• **Eliminated Loopback Policy Drops**: Removed local loopback attempts that caused `policy drop` control channel errors.

### 🖼 Wallpapers (.tendies) — Collections & Mercury Fixes
• **Dual Injection on iOS 18+**: Wallpapers are now injected into both their primary bundle (`com.apple.WallpaperKit.CollectionsPoster` or `com.apple.MercuryPoster`) and the modern iOS 18+ application container (`com.apple.Posters.CollectionsPosterApp` / `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp`).
• **Metadata Synchronization**: Fix

apps.name: iPadn
apps.subtitle: 下载安装你拥有的 App
apps.localizedDescription:
在 iPhone 和 iPad 上搜索、下载、安装你拥有的 App：历史版本、已下架应用、多地区比价与原生安装。安装包未签名，请用自己的工具签名后安装。

项目主页：https://github.com/mengangs/ipadn
apps.versionDescription:
## iPadn 2.0.0

iPadn 2.0 是一次大更新：新增发现页、用户评论、翻译、应用锁、本机应用、Wi‑Fi 传输、灵动岛下载进度、小组件和快捷指令，原生安装可以阻止 App Store 更新，并开始支持 iOS / iPadOS 16。安装包未签名，请用自己的工具签名后安装。

**两个安装包**

- `iPadn-2.0.0-unsigned.ipa`：标准版，包含实时活动（灵动岛、锁屏）和小组件，签名时需要 2 个 App ID。
- `iPadn-2.0.0-lite-unsigned.ipa`：精简版，不含扩展，只需 1 个 App ID，适合 App ID 数量有限的签名方式。其他功能相同。
- SideStore、AltStore、Feather 等签名工具可以添加源 `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengangs/ipadn/main/altstore-source.json`，在工具里直接安装和更新。

**发现与应用详情**

- 搜索页新增「发现」：免费榜、付费榜、畅销榜，可切换地区并按分类筛选。
- 详情页新增「评论」，可查看各地区最近的用户评论并按星级筛选。
- 简介和更新说明不是你的语言时，可以用系统翻译替换为译文（iOS 17.4 及更新版本）。
- 版本历史默认显示最近 5 个版本。

**下载与安装**

- 锁屏和灵动岛显示下载进度（可在设置中关闭）。
- 新增「仅使用 Wi‑Fi 下载」和「下载完成后自动安装」。
- 下载页可以「全部更新」，编辑模式改为紧凑列表并支持全选。
- 任务详情新增「安装包信息」：权限、扩展、语言、URL Scheme、后台模式等。
- 原生安装新增「阻止 App Store 更新」：App Store 会把应用视为最新版本，不再提示或自动更新；关闭后再安装一次即可恢复（#46）。
- 新增「账号 › 本机应用」：列出手机上已装的应用，对比 App Store 版本并一键全部更新（需要原生安装的配对）。
- 新增「账号 › Wi‑Fi 传输」：在同一 Wi‑Fi 的电脑浏览器中下载已完成的安装包，只在页面打开时运行，地址带随机密钥。
- 在 LiveContainer 中运行时，会提示打开 LiveContainer 的「修复文件导入」，之后才能导入导出文件和一键安装（#44）。

**关注与价格**

- 关注的付费应用可以设置目标价，降到目标价才提醒。

**安全与快捷操作**

- 新增应用锁：面容 ID、触控 ID 或密码，可设置离开多久后需要验证，多任务界面中也会隐藏内容。
- 新增主屏幕和锁屏小组件：快速打开搜索、下载、已购和更新检查。
- 新增快捷指令：下载应用、检查更新、下载全部更新、获取下载进度、暂停或继续全部下载、关注应用。

**专业模式**

- 可以对比同一应用的两个已下载版本：版本、权限、扩展、框架等变化。

**设置**

- 设置首页改为分类入口；新增「备份与维护」导出、导入设置和关注列表（不含账号和安装包）。
- 关闭「新版本提醒」后，下载页也不再显示更新提示。

**系统支持与稳定性**

- 支持 iOS / iPadOS 16 及更新版本（感谢 @tageniu）。
- 修复部分安装包（如网易云音乐）的图标导致 iPadn 启动后崩溃。
- 切换标签页更流畅：不再每次重建所有页面（#41）。

**English**

iPadn 2.0 adds Discover (top charts by region and category), customer reviews, system translation of descriptions and release notes, App Lock, Apps on This Device, Wi‑Fi transfer to a computer, download progress on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, widgets and Shortcuts actions. Downloads can wait for Wi‑Fi and install automatically when finished; native installation can block App Store updates for an app. Package info shows what a package declares, and Pro mode compares two downloaded versions. Followed paid apps can ha

apps.name: WQ Files
apps.subtitle: 文件浏览器与缓存清理
apps.localizedDescription:
iOS 26/27 的文件浏览器、应用数据管理与缓存清理，无需越狱。需要 iOS 27 或 iOS 26.0–26.7.2；签名时须保留 App Group 权限。

项目主页：https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles
apps.versionDescription:
> **Requires:** iOS 27, or iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1 and 26.7.1; iOS 27.3 beta support is based on a user's Log.
> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.

# Worse Query Files 0.9.5

## New

- **iOS 27.3 beta** ([#50](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/50)): WQ Files reads the app database of iOS 27.3, where app extensions are stored differently. Before, most folders on 27.3 stayed unidentified, and the Cache Cleaner couldn't clean them.
- **Turkish**, and a **flag next to each language** under **Language** in WQ Files' Settings.
- **Import several files at once with Replace All** ([#49](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/49)): when some names already exist, WQ Files asks once: **Replace All** (each replaced file is backed up first) or **Keep Both**.
- **Rename in Select** ([#41](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/41)): with one item selected, **Rename** is in the toolbar.
- **Restore edited app backups:** a backup whose files were swapped afterwards, for example with files from another backup tool, used to be refused. WQ Files now says which parts changed and offers **Restore Anyway**. The app's current data is still backed up first.

## Changed

- **Deleting folders:** the alert now says how many files are backed up and how many links or special files are removed without a backup, instead of promising a copy of everything.
- **Recently Deleted:** shows when Backups can't be read instead of "Nothing deleted". A failed restore removes the empty folders it created.
- **Share as ZIP:** asks before sharing when items couldn't be read and were left out. The container's own system file doesn't count.
- **SQLite:**
  - **Saving** keeps one complete backup of the previous database, including changes that were still only in the `-wal` file.
  - **Text** that can't be shown exactly (invalid UTF-8, embedded NUL) is shown

# Worse Query Files 0.9.5

## New

- **iOS 27.3 beta** ([#50](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/50)): WQ Files reads the app database of iOS 27.3, where app extensions are stored differently. Before, most folders on 27.3 stayed unidentified, and the Cache Cleaner couldn't clean them.
- **Turkish**, and a **flag next to each language** under **Language** in WQ Files' Settings.
- **Import several files at once with Replace All** ([#49](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/49)): when some names already exist, WQ Files asks once: **Replace All** (each replaced file is backed up first) or **Keep Both**.
- **Rename in Select** ([#41](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/41)): with one item selected, **Rename** is in the toolbar.
- **Restore edited app backups:** a backup whose files were swapped afterwards, for example with files from another backup tool, used to be refused. WQ Files now says which parts changed and offers **Restore Anyway**. The app's current data is still backed up first.

## Changed

- **Deleting folders:** the alert now says how many files are backed up and how many links or special files are removed without a backup, instead of promising a copy of everything.
- **Recently Deleted:** shows when Backups can't be read instead of "Nothing deleted". A failed restore removes the empty folders it created.
- **Share as ZIP:** asks before sharing when items couldn't be read and were left out. The container's own system file doesn't count.
- **SQLite:**
  - **Saving** keeps one complete backup of the previous database, including changes that were still only in the `-wal` file.
  - **Text** that can't be shown exactly (invalid UTF-8, embedded NUL) is shown

releases.localizedDescription:
> **Requires:** iOS 27, or iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1 and 26.7.1; iOS 27.3 beta support is based on a user's Log.
> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.
